summary: Refresh stale internal dependencies in uv.lock (clickmd, costs, goal) and drop orphaned lock entries

delivery.outcome: uv.lock pins the published stable targets of the internal dependencies (clickmd 1.1.16, costs 0.2.1, goal 2.2.1), so the scheduled and pull-request dependency-freshness check passes, and no longer carries entries for the removed pfix dependency and its transitive packages.
nonGoals: Do not change pyproject.toml or any declared dependency range.
Do not change the protected local verifier pins; that control lives in another repository.

architecture.decision: Run the command reported by `goal dependencies --check` (`uv lock --upgrade-package ...`) and commit only the resulting uv.lock after the locked CI recipe passes.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-228 commit; uv.lock returns to the previous resolution.
